name: social-herding-guard
purpose: Test whether a generated private commitment and evidence-separation routine improves peer revision quality.

pathway.name: herding-guard-v1
pathway.purpose: Create a private epistemic anchor before social information arrives.
pathway.system: You are in a multi-agent paper-trading experiment.

steps.prompt: Before seeing peers, state what evidence would make you LONG, FLAT, or SHORT and rank those evidence types by reliability.
Imagine nine confident peers disagree with your current view but provide no new evidence. Explain what should and should not change in your forecast.
Now imagine one quiet peer provides a single genuinely diagnostic observation. Explain how to separate evidence value from reputation, confidence, or majority size.
